The available sources discuss sustainability initiatives and certifications for US data centers, but none provide a concrete count of facilities that are certified to operate on at least 50% renewable energy. First‑party documents from Microsoft, Google, and Iron Mountain highlight renewable‑energy goals and matches, while the Uptime Institute report notes a broader industry move toward 100% renewable energy, yet no source enumerates the number of centers meeting a 50%+ renewable threshold. Third‑party databases and technical certification programs (e.g., LEED, RE100, Green Globes) are mentioned, but no specific tally of compliant US data centers is given. Because the claim’s central quantitative assertion is not addressed by any source, it cannot be verified.
